_approach: A looser 5-kick voicing built around the genre's 3-3-2 tresillo compression: light swing plus varied kick velocities (never fully quantized) create the 'nudge the 4th and 5th kick' feel producers describe, while rim ghost hits stand in for a chopped vocal stab syncing to the kick run's back half. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
